name: Shikamachi (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Shikamachi town emblem in white: an outlined ring with a small disc at the top, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Shikamachi in Nagasaki Prefecture, dissolved on 2010-03-31.

features.role: Shikamachi town emblem — an outlined ring with a small disc at the top, enclosing a stylised character
